A.summary: approval_request_id + approved = true; the chat click is the decision; no digest, expiry or single use; resume runs the agent's pending action if the boolean is true
A.title: Naive boolean

B.summary: approval artifact bound to request, action, resource, parameters and digest; authenticated, eligible approver; expiry; single use marked after the call; no revalidation on resume
B.title: Action-bound

C.summary: B's decision path, plus on resume: atomic consume, identity, delegation, policy, resource state, approval validity and digest re-checked; idempotency key; credential minted after revalidation
C.title: Revalidated protocol
